rubric.role_summary: Remote US travel support role handling booking changes, air ticketing and refunds, and customer inquiries by email, phone, and chat.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Remote US travel support role handling booking changes, air ticketing and refunds, and customer inquiries by email, phone, and chat.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- At least 3 years of experience using a GDS.
- Strong knowledge of air fares, ticketing, re-issues and refunds.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Travelport/Galileo or Sabre GDS experience preferred.
- Experience with NDC systems such as Farelogix SPRK or IAG TAP strongly preferred.
- Experience using Zendesk for customer support queries preferred.
- Previous experience with BSP Link or knowledge of ARC preferred.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): United States. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
